intro_html: Chili and mac and cheese had a baby, and it happens to be loaded with protein. This one-skillet meal hits a serious 56 grams of protein per serving for around $4.99 (at everyday cost), and it makes 14 hearty bowls. Comfort food that actually works for your goals and your wallet.
cost_closing_html: About $4.99 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a high-protein dinner that beats takeout on price and macros.
portion_html: Each of the 14 bowls brings 56 grams of protein at 568 calories, making this one of the highest-protein plates in the lineup.
upsell_html: One pan, a pile of protein, and the kind of dinner that makes leftovers something to look forward to. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: Grab the store-brand canned beans and tomatoes. They are the same beans and tomatoes as the name brand for less, and this recipe uses a stack of them.
Undercook the pasta by a minute so it holds its bite after reheating all week instead of going mushy.
One seasoning packet or a spoonful of chili powder from a jar you already own beats buying pricey pre-made chili kits.
make_it: Brown 6.6 pounds of 93/7 ground turkey with the chopped onion in a large skillet.
Boil the penne pasta separately until just shy of tender, then drain.
Stir the black beans, diced tomatoes, and tomato paste into the turkey and let it simmer.
Fold in the cooked pasta so every noodle catches the chili.
Melt the fat-free cheddar over the top and stir it through before you portion it out.

head.description: A high-protein American meal prep. Fourteen servings at about 568 calories and 56 grams of protein for roughly $4.99 each (at everyday cost).
